import sys

def main():
    s = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    i = 0
    nbInsert = 0
    occ = 1

    while i < len(s) - 1:
        if s[i] == s[i + 1]:
            occ += 1
        else:
            if occ % 2 == 0:
                nbInsert += 1
            occ = 1
        i += 1

    if occ % 2 == 0:
        nbInsert += 1

    print(nbInsert)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
